#rust #architecture

No DI framework in our Rust services, and I'd like to keep it that way. Each service has an `AppState` struct built once in `main.rs`: `Arc<dyn LedgerStore>`, `Arc<dyn FxProvider>`, `Arc<dyn Clock>`. Handlers get it through axum's `State` extractor. Tests build their own `AppState` with `InMemoryLedger` and `FixedClock::at("2025-03-01T09:00:00Z")`, no mocking library. Leni proposed `shaku` in April 2025; I counted 212 lines of macro attributes in her spike branch against 38 lines for the hand-written version, and that was the end of that. Trait objects cost a vtable call, which is irrelevant next to a 4 ms Postgres round trip. One rule: `new()` takes traits, never concrete Postgres types, otherwise [[Pruebas de integración]] can't swap them out. Same idea in event form: [[Entwurfsmuster Beobachter]].
